Queue depth (Kafka consumer lag) per workflow and consuming node, for
the projects the caller collaborates on.

available=False means the broker was unreachable and counts are omitted.
The cached result behind this covers the whole grid - it is shared by
every caller and by internal users like the Monitor list - so the filter
is applied to the response rather than to the cache.
